Shape-preserving smoothing of a triangular surface mesh

Source: R/shape_smoothing.R
shape_smoothing.Rd

Smooths a triangulated surface while preserving its overall shape, using CGAL's mean curvature flow algorithm.

Usage

shape_smoothing(
  mesh,
  n_iterations = 1L,
  time_step = 1e-04,
  update_attributes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mesh

A mesh3d object.

n_iterations

Number of smoothing iterations. Default 1L.

time_step

Controls the smoothing speed. Smaller values give a more conservative smoothing. Default 1e-4.

update_attributes

Whether to interpolate point and cell data from the input. Default TRUE.

Value

A mesh3d object with the smoothed surface.

See also

Other mesh_transforms: alpha_wrapping(), boolean_operation(), isotropic_remeshing(), mesh_check(), mesh_deformation(), mesh_smoothing(), mesh_subdivision(), patch_filling(), pca_estimate_normals(), poisson_reconstruction(), region_fairing()

Examples

# \donttest{
f <- system.file("extdata", "torus.stl", package = "vespa")
mesh <- read_stl(f)
result <- shape_smoothing(mesh, n_iterations = 2L)
# }
